title: Typing maths answers
intro: Read this once before the maths answer questions.

blocks.title: equivalent answers
blocks.body: Any equal form is accepted: $(x-1)(x+1)$ and $x^2-1$ are the same. When a question says **expand** or **factorise**, the form counts too.
Check the preview above the box. If it does not look like your maths, fix the typing before you check.
